sceneCommands.description: GIT SetVisibility and SCP SetVisibility select scene instances by name=. Each name token immediately overwrites the selected handle, including failed lookup; only the final selection is changed. Matching is case-insensitive. A FALSE substring in a token without name= latches visibility off; later TRUE does not turn it back on. SCP runs only on first call and always returns 1. GIT has no entry-call gate.

sceneLookup.description: Current scene is world+0x13c. With scene+0x110 null, search static records using count+0x24, base+0x28, stride0x4c, name pointer+0x44. Otherwise search dynamic container+0x6c count/+0x70 base, stride0xd0, name pointer+0xb4. Both choose the first case-insensitive match. The dynamic branch has a separate external fallback when global 0x97388c is nonzero; that fallback is not established here.

sceneFlags.description: Static visibility changes instance flag0x200 and, if bounds exists, only bounds+0x44 bit0. Dynamic visibility changes flags+0xb8 bits0x202 together. If dynamic container byte+0x76 bit0 is set, it also changes bit0 in auxiliary byte array at container+0x48 indexed by instance+0xc0. Other bits are preserved. Fixture inputs are boolean; arbitrary nonboolean call values are outside the portable API.

gizmoGit.description: GIT SetGizmoVisibility scans name= before type= before a FALSE substring. The last name and type win; false latches. Type lookup is case-sensitive. Missing/unknown type resolves to -1 and searches all registered types in order. Object names are matched case-insensitively within type order, then handle order. Only the first match is changed.

gizmoScript.description: SCP GizmoSetVisibility always returns 1 and acts only on first call. Each name= token immediately selects through an all-type name search in world+0x2ac8, including clearing the selection on failure. It recognizes FALSE only as a whole-token case-insensitive match. Unlike the GIT command, a token containing prefixFALSEsuffix is ignored.

callback.description: Both gizmo commands call original wrapper 0x55a2b0. A type must provide a visibility callback. Hiding first invokes its activation callback with false, then its visibility callback; showing invokes visibility without activation. Native fixtures use actual NuSpecial callbacks, stop its animation when hidden, and update the static scene/bounds flags. Other type-specific effects remain callbacks.

verification.method: Unmodified PC scene/gizmo command functions, original scene/type/name lookup, native visibility wrapper and real NuSpecial animation/scene callbacks. Code hooks observe arguments only; no function replacement. Synthetic finite registries and scene records.

portable.status: Core and comparison harness compile with C# 5. Managed execution/differential comparison pending.
adapters: Host constructs scene/type/object registries in native runtime order.
Scene record flags are a portable data projection; host propagates them to its actual renderer/scene.
Type-specific physical behavior is represented by GizmoCallbacks; only real NuSpecial native paths were included in these fixtures.
hostGuards: Direct gizmo lookup at typeIndex==typeCount throws instead of reproducing a native table overread. Command FindType cannot produce that index.
ASCII token domain; dynamic fallback function is not simulated.

remaining: Synthetic category labels for authored type= arguments use NuSpecial callbacks to validate command dispatch; distinct GizForce/GizObstacle/etc physical implementations are not validated.
Dynamic scene fallback global 0x97388c is zero; external named fallback function 0x5c1300 remains outside scope.
Static scene and dynamic scene branches are tested separately, with at most three name entries, first duplicate match and current scene binding.
